title: Eastern Bok Choi Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious pilaf dish featuring bok choi and a blend of Eastern spices.

ingredients.name: Bok Choi
ingredients.notes: Separate the leaves and cut in half

ingredients.name: Eastern spices
ingredients.notes: Blend of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the pilaf mix and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Add the separated bok choi leaves and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 5-7 minutes until the pilaf is tender.
Stir in Eastern spices and salt (if using).
